1735.note: 第十三 wā 是第十二 wā 的一个旁支（*He lala no ka wa umikumamalua*），从兄长 Paliku 一系续起；其弟 ‘Ololo 一系已在第十二 wā 排到瓦凯亚。附录二：从此行起，以下四 wā 谱系中的男名前都有强调词 *O*，表明出自与前面不同的来源。Beckwith 未逐行英译这些谱系（[[ku:20]]）。

1749.zh: 生了 Kapapa-pahu 为长，其后的 Ka-po-he‘enalu 承续谱系
1749.note: 附录二：底本作 *mai kona hope noho*。

1754.zh: 在 Pu‘ukahonualani 中生了 Li‘aikuhonua，其后是 Ohomaila
1754.note: *Pu‘u-ka-honua-lani*，Beckwith 译作“天地显现之处”。Li‘aikuhonua 一系由兄长续于第十四 wā（1814 行），本 wā 由其弟续下（[[ku:21]]）。

1760.en: Mulinaha was the husband, 'Ipo'i the wife
1760.note: Beckwith 认为 ‘Ipo‘i（“至上的情人”）或可与 1904 年委员会报告所引谱系中与卡纳洛亚结合的 Uhiuhi-ka-‘ipo-i-wai 相认同，也可能就是豪梅亚本人（[[ku:20]]、[[ku:24]]）。

1761.en: Born was Laumiha a woman, lived with Ku-ka-haku-a-lani ["Ku-the-lord-of-heaven"]
1761.zh: 生了 Laumiha，是女，与 Kekahakualani 同住
1761.note: Beckwith 把三个丈夫名都读作以 Ku 起首：Ku-ka-haku-a-lani（天上之主库）、Ku-huli-honua（翻转大地的库）、Ku-lani-‘ehu（褐发酋长库）。附录二：Kamokuiki 谱系本把这四个女子列为 Mulinaha 与 ‘Ipo‘i 的女儿。

1762.en: Born was Kaha'ula a woman, lived with Ku-huli-honua ["Ku-overturning-earth"]
1762.zh: 生了 Kaha‘ula，是女，与 Kuhulionua 同住

1763.en: Born was Kahakauakoko a woman, lived with Ku-lani-'ehu ["Ku-(the)-brown-haired-chief"]
1763.zh: 生了 Kahakauakoko，是女，与 Kulani‘ehu 同住

1764.en: Born was Haumea a woman, lived with the god Kanaloa
1764.zh: 生了豪梅亚，是女，与卡纳洛亚神同住
1764.note: Beckwith 说豪梅亚之名不见于其他夏威夷谱系的这一位置；只有在芒阿雷瓦，Haumea 是 Tagaroa（即卡纳洛亚）之妻（[[ku:20]]、[[ku:24]]）。

1765.en: Born was Ku-kaua-kahi a male, lived with Kuaimehani
1765.zh: 生了 Kuleauakahi，是男，与女子 Kuaimehani 同住
1765.note: Beckwith 读作 Ku-kaua-kahi（“初次争斗的兴起”），认为与豪梅亚和卡纳洛亚的结合引起某种变革有关（[[ku:24]]）。附录二：底本作 *Kuaimehana*，据 1948 行改。

1767.en: Born was Hina-mano-ulua'e ["Woman-of-abundance-of food-plants"] a woman
1767.note: Beckwith 译作“丰饶食用植物之女”。

1771.en: Born was Hikapuanaiea ["Sickly"] a woman; Haumea was recognized, this was Haumea
1771.zh: 生了 Hikapuanaiea，是女；豪梅亚被认出，这就是豪梅亚
1771.note: Beckwith 把 Hikapuanaiea 译作“病弱者”。她说这些女子都是豪梅亚形形色色的化身（[[ku:20]]）。

1772.en: Haumea of mysterious forms, Haumea of eightfold forms
1772.zh: 形体神秘的豪梅亚，八重形体的豪梅亚
1772.note: *paha‘oha‘o*，神秘莫测；第九 wā 也用此词形容拉伊拉伊。

1773.en: Haumea of four-hundred-thousand-fold forms, Haumea of four-thousand-fold forms
1773.zh: 四十万重形体的豪梅亚，四千重形体的豪梅亚
1773.note: *lehu* 四十万，*mano* 四千，都是夏威夷的计数单位。

1774.en: With thousands upon thousands of forms

1775.en: With Hikapuanaiea the heavenly one became barren
1775.zh: 到了 Hikapuanaiea，天上的那位绝了生育

1776.en: She lived like a dog, this woman of Nu'umea [?]
1776.zh: 她像狗一样生活，这 Nu‘umea 的女人 [?]

1777.en: Nu'umea the land, Nu'u-papa-kini the division
1777.zh: Nu‘umea 是那地，Nu‘upapakini 是那地区

1779.en: With Ki'o she became barren, ceased bearing children
1779.zh: 到了 Ki‘o，她绝了生育，不再产子
1779.note: Beckwith 认为与 Ki‘o（“诸酋长由他而散布”）的断裂，或表示卡纳洛亚祭司制度下的社会秩序在新政权下瓦解（[[ku:20]]）。

1780.en: This woman bore children through the fontanel
1780.note: *manawa*，婴儿头顶的囟门；夏威夷人说囟门就来自豪梅亚的生育方式（[[ku:20]]）。

1781.en: Her children came out from the brain

1782.en: She was a woman of 'I'ilipo in Nu'umea
1782.zh: 她是 Nu‘umea 的 ‘I‘ilipo 的女人

1784.en: Born was Laumiha ["Intense-silence"] born from the brain
1784.note: Beckwith 译名为“深沉的寂静”。

1785.en: Born was the woman Kaha'ula ["Erotic-dreams"] from the brain
1785.zh: 生了女儿 Kaha‘ula，从脑中生出

1786.en: Born was Ka-haka-uakoko ["The-perch-of-the-low-lying rainbow"] from the brain
1786.note: Beckwith 译名为“低垂之虹的栖处”。

1787.en: Haumea was this, that same woman
1787.zh: 这就是豪梅亚，就是那个女人

1788.en: She lived with the god Kanaloa

1789.en: The god Kaua-kai ["First-strife"] was born from the brain
1789.note: Kaua-kahi，“初次争斗”。Beckwith 说这位战神不见于其他夏威夷的创世谱系（[[ku:24]]）。

1790.en: Born from the brain were the offspring of that woman
1790.zh: 那女人的子孙都从脑中生出

1791.en: Drivelers were the offspring from the brain
1791.zh: 从脑中生出的子孙流着口水
1791.note: 今天夏威夷人仍把流口水的孩子叫作“豪梅亚从脑中生的孩子”（[[ku:20]]）。

1792.note: 以下是献给瓦凯亚之妻帕帕的一段结语。瓦凯亚为与女儿相会而设夜间禁忌、欺瞒帕帕的故事，见[[ku:21]]与第一本书[[ch:20]]。

1799.en: He ordered the sun, the moon

1800.en: The night to Kane for the younger
1800.note: Kāne 与 Hilo 都是夏威夷太阴月中夜晚的名称：Hilo 是新月第一夜，Kāne 在月末。传说瓦凯亚借规定禁忌之夜，使夫妻分居。

1801.en: The night to Hilo for the first-born

1802.en: Taboo was the house platform, the place for sitting

1803.en: Taboo the house where Wakea lived
1803.zh: 瓦凯亚所住的屋子禁忌

1804.en: Taboo was intercourse with the divine parent
1804.note: 字面如此；Beckwith 译作“与神圣父母交合禁忌”。

1805.en: Taboo the taro plant, the acrid one
1805.note: *‘ape*，大叶的芋类植物，生食辛辣刺口。

1806.note: *‘akia*，一种瑞香科灌木，可用作毒鱼药。

1808.note: *‘uhaloa*，常用的草药；*no ke ola loa*，“为了长寿”。

1809.en: Taboo the bitter part of the taro leaf

1810.en: Taboo the taro stalk that stood by the woman's taboo house
1810.zh: 立在女人禁忌屋旁的芋茎禁忌

1811.en: Haloa was buried [there], a long taro stalk grew
1811.zh: 哈洛阿被埋下，长出长长的芋茎
1811.note: 瓦凯亚的第一个孩子是死胎，埋在屋旁，长出芋头，名为 *Hāloa*（长茎）；其后出生的活子也叫哈洛阿，是人类的始祖（[[ku:21]]、第一本书[[ch:20]]）。

1812.en: The offspring of Haloa [born] into the day
1812.zh: 哈洛阿的后代来到白昼

1814.note: Beckwith 说 Li‘aikuhonua 在较通行的版本中作 Huli-honua；其妻 Ke-aka-huli-honua 可与芒阿雷瓦的 Atanua（Tagaroa 之妻）相比（[[ku:24]]）。此 wā 先列三十对夫妇，然后生出瓦凯亚（[[ku:21]]）。

1845.zh: 与 Kahiko 同住，即 Kahiko-luamea

1846.note: Beckwith 读作 Pau-pani-a[wa]kea，“遮光的终结”：*awakea* 是正午，无影之时。她联想到南方天父地母分离、光明进入世界的神话（[[ku:21]]）。

1847.en: This was Wakea; [born was) Lehu'ula; [born was] Makulu-kulu-the-chief
1847.zh: 那就是瓦凯亚；[又生了] Lehu‘ula，Makulukulukalani
1847.note: 附录二：Kamokuiki 谱系本作“瓦凯亚为酋长，Makulu 为仆从，Lihauula 为祭司”。据较晚的传说，三人是酋长、祭司、平民三个阶层的始祖（[[ku:21]]）。

1848.en: Their youngest, a man of great bundles
1848.zh: 他们最小的，是背着大包裹的人
1848.note: Beckwith 认为以下排列的“悬在天上的星”象征 Makahiki 等节庆时用扁担挑来献给主上的贡品包裹（[[ku:21]]）。

1849.en: Collected and placed with Makali'i; fixed fast
1849.zh: 聚集起来，放在马卡利伊那里，牢固了
1849.note: 马卡利伊（Makali‘i），昴星团；Makahiki 节以昴星黄昏升起为始。

1850.en: Fixed are the stars suspended in the sky
1850.zh: 牢固了，群星悬挂在天空
1850.note: 1850–1900 行的星名，Beckwith 说底本错乱极多，据 Makemson 的星名表校订；方括号中的星名比定也出自 Makemson（[[ku:21]]）。*lewa*，悬荡、摇摆。

1852.en: Ha'i swings that way, Ha'i swings this way
1852.zh: Ha‘i 往那边摇荡，Ha‘i 往这边摇荡

1853.en: Kaha'i swings, swings Kaha'iha'i [in the Milky Way]

1854.en: Swings Kaua, the star cluster Wahilaninui

1855.en: Swings the flower of the heavens, Kaulua-i-ha'imoha'i
1855.zh: 天上的花朵 Kaulua-i-ha‘imohai 摇荡

1856.en: Puanene swings, the star that reveals a lord
1856.zh: Puanene 摇荡，那显示主上的星

1858.en: Wainaku [patron star of Hilo] swings, swings Ikapa'a
1858.note: Wainaku，Beckwith 注为希洛的守护星。

1860.zh: Pouhanu‘u 摇荡，红肤的 Ka‘ili‘ula 摇荡

1861.en: Swings Kapakapaka, [and the morning star) Mananalo [Jupiter or Venus]
1861.note: Mananalo，Beckwith 注为晨星（木星或金星）。

1862.en: Swings Kona, swings Wailea [patron star of Maui]
1862.note: Wailea，Beckwith 注为毛伊岛的守护星。

1863.en: Swings the Auhaku, swings the Eye-of-Unulau
1863.zh: Auhaku 摇荡，Unulau 之眼摇荡

1864.zh: 天上的希娜 Hinalani 摇荡，Keoea 摇荡

1865.en: Ka'aka'a swings, swings Polo'ula [star of Oahu]

1867.en: Swings Kalalani [of Lanai], swings [the astrologers' star] Kekepue
1867.note: Beckwith 注：Kalalani 为拉奈岛之星，Kekepue 为星象家之星。

1868.en: Swings Ka'alolo [of Ni'ihau], swings the Resting-place-of-the-sun [Kaulana-a-ka-la]
1868.zh: Ka‘alolo 摇荡，太阳的栖处 Kaulana-a-ka-la 摇荡
1868.note: Ka‘alolo，Beckwith 注为尼伊豪岛之星。

1873.note: ‘A‘a，Beckwith 英译作 Wa，注为天狼星。

1875.zh: 尖鼻 Ihu-ku 摇荡，鸡鼻 Ihu-moa 摇荡

1880.note: Welo、Ikiiki、Ka‘aona、Hinaia‘ele‘ele、Kaulua、Nana 等也是夏威夷月份的名称。

1883.en: Swings Hikikauelia [Sirius of navigators], swings Ka'elo
1883.note: Hikikauelia，Beckwith 注为航海者所称的天狼星。

1884.en: Swings Kapawa, swings Hikikaulonomeha [Sirius of astrologers]
1884.note: Hikikaulonomeha，Beckwith 注为星象家所称的天狼星。

1887.en: Uliuli swings, Melemele swings [two lands of old]
1887.note: Beckwith 注：两处古老的地方。

1888.en: Swings the Pleiades, Makali'i, swings the Cluster, na Huihui
1888.zh: 马卡利伊摇荡，星团 Na-huihui 摇荡

1889.note: Beckwith 注：Kokoiki 是卡美哈梅哈之星，Humu 是河鼓二（牛郎星）。

1892.en: Swings Kamalie, swings Kamalie the first
1892.zh: Kamalie 摇荡，前 Kamalie 摇荡
1892.note: 附录二：1892–1893 或即 Makemson 的 *Maile-mua*、*Maile-hope*。

1894.zh: 黄天之希娜 Hina-o-na-lailena 摇荡

1895.en: Swing the Seven, na Hiku. [Big Dipper], swings the first of the Seven
1895.zh: 七星 Na Hiku 摇荡，第一星摇荡

1896.en: The second of the Seven, the third of the Seven
1896.zh: 第二星摇荡，第三星摇荡

1897.en: The fourth of the Seven, the fifth of the Seven
1897.zh: 第四星摇荡，第五星摇荡

1898.en: The sixth of the Seven, the last of the Seven
1898.zh: 第六星摇荡，最后一星摇荡

1900.zh: 猎户的标枪 Na Kao 摇荡

1901.en: Sown was the seed of Makali'i, seed of the heavens
1901.zh: 撒下了马卡利伊的种子，天的种子

1902.en: Sown was the seed of the gods, the sun is a god
1902.zh: 撒下了神的种子，太阳是神

1903.en: Sown was the seed of Hina, an afterbirth of Lono-muku
1903.zh: 撒下了希娜的种子，那是 Lonomuku 的胞衣
1903.note: Lonomuku，“残缺的洛诺”。Beckwith 解释：希娜逃往月亮时，丈夫抓住她，扯下她一条腿，由此长出甘薯（[[ku:21]]）。

1904.en: The food of Hina-ia-ka-malama as Waka

1905.en: She was found by Wakea in the deep sea
1905.zh: 她在深海被瓦凯亚找到

1906.en: In a sea of coral, a turbulent sea

1907.en: Hina-ia-ka-malama floated as a bailing gourd
1907.zh: Hina-ia-ka-malama 漂浮着，是一只舀水瓢
1907.note: 化为舀水瓢搭上独木舟的变形把戏，南太平洋故事中常见，但 Beckwith 说在那里总是男性变形者所为（[[ku:21]]）。

1908.en: Was hung up in the canoes, hence called Hina-the-bailer [-ke-ka]
1908.zh: 被挂在独木舟上，因此称为舀水瓢希娜 Hina-ke-ka

1909.en: Taken ashore, set by the fire
1909.note: “放在火边”是性交的委婉说法（[[ku:21]]）。

1910.en: Born were corals, born the eels

1911.en: Born were the small sea urchins, the large sea urchins
1911.zh: 生了小海胆，生了大海胆

1912.en: The blackstone was born, the volcanic stone was born

1913.en: Hence she was called Woman-from-whose-womb-come-various-forms, Hinahalakoa
1913.note: Beckwith 译作“腹中生出种种形体的女人”。

1914.en: Hina craved food, Wakea went to fetch it
1914.zh: 希娜想吃东西，瓦凯亚去取

1915.en: [He] set up images on the platform
1915.note: *ki‘i*，神像，也是基伊之名；神像与独木舟都是公认的男性象征（[[ku:21]]）。

1916.en: Set them up neatly in a row

1917.en: Wakea as Ki'i [image] slept with Hina-ka-we'o-a
1917.zh: 瓦凯亚化作神像，与 Hina-kaweo‘a 同眠
1917.note: Beckwith 认为此希娜就是第十五 wā 中毛伊之母 Hina-a-ke-ahi（火之希娜）（[[ku:21]]）。

1918.en: Born was the cock, perched on Wakea's back
1918.zh: 生了公鸡，栖在瓦凯亚背上
1918.note: *moa*，公鸡，也用来称高级酋长。第十一 wā 末也提到“瓦凯亚背上的公鸡”（[[ku:21]]）。

1919.en: The cock scratched the back of Wakea
1919.zh: 公鸡在瓦凯亚背上抓挠

1920.en: Wakea was jealous, tried to brush it away
1920.zh: 瓦凯亚恼怒，要把它拂去

1921.en: Wakea was jealous, vexed and annoyed

1922.en: Thrust away the cock and it flew to the ridgepole
1922.zh: 推开公鸡，它飞上了屋脊
1922.note: 影子落在禁忌酋长头上即是死罪；公鸡高踞屋脊，意味着儿子的品级高过父亲（[[ku:21]]）。

1923.en: The cock was on the ridgepole

1925.en: This was the seed of The-high-one
1925.zh: 这是至高者 Ka‘eo‘eo 的种子

1930.en: Haumea, woman of Nu'umea in Kukuiha'a
1930.zh: 豪梅亚，Kukuiha‘a 那里 Nu‘umea 的女人
1930.note: 本 wā 开头这段诗体序曲再讲豪梅亚：她因嫉妒丈夫的第二个伴侣而“化为女人”，嫁给人间男子，住在瓦胡岛的 Kalihi 谷，最后化入一棵面包树（[[ku:20]]）。

1931.en: Of Mehani the impenetrable land of Kuaihealani in Paliuli
1931.zh: 来自 Mehani，帕利乌利中库艾赫拉尼那不可穿越的土地

1932.en: The beautiful, the dark [land], darkening the heavens
1932.zh: 美丽而幽暗，[那地方] 使天空暗沉

1933.en: A solitude for the heavenly one, Kameha-'i-kaua [?]

1934.zh: Kameha‘ikaua，“战中至尊的幽隐者”，Kauakahi 的神

1935.en: At the parting of earth, at the parting of high heaven
1935.zh: 在大地分开之时，在高天分开之时

1936.en: Left the land, jealous of her husband's second mate
1936.zh: 她离开那里，嫉妒丈夫的第二个伴侣

1937.en: Came to the land of Lua, to 'Ahu of Lua, lived at Wawau
1937.zh: 来到 Lua 之地，来到 Lua 的 ‘Ahu，住在 Wawau

1938.en: The goddess became the wife of Makea
1938.zh: 女神做了 Makea 的妻子

1939.en: Haumea became a woman of Kalihi in Ko'olau
1939.zh: 豪梅亚成了 Ko‘olau 地区 Kalihi 的女人
1939.note: Kalihi 谷在瓦胡岛。民间传说指 Kalihi 的 Kai‘ele 神庙为她由老变少之处（[[ku:20]]）。

1940.en: Lived in Kalihi on the edge of the cliff Laumilia
1940.zh: 住在 Kalihi，Laumiha 崖的边上

1941.en: Entered a growing tree, she became a breadfruit tree
1941.zh: 进入正在生长的树中，她成了一棵面包树

1942.en: A breadfruit body, a trunk and leaves she had
1942.zh: 面包树的身体，面包树的树干，面包树的叶子

1943.en: Many forms had this woman Haumea
1943.zh: 这女人豪梅亚有许多形体

1944.zh: 伟大的豪梅亚神秘莫测
1944.note: *aiwaiwa*，神秘、非凡；毛伊也被称为 *aiwaiwa* 之子（2094 行前后）。

1945.en: Mysterious was Haumea in the way she lived
1945.zh: 豪梅亚的生活方式神秘莫测

1948.en: Slept with her child Kauakahi as [?] the wife Kuaimehani
1948.zh: 与儿子 Kauakahi 同眠，Kuaimehani 为妻
1948.note: 以下几行“某某为妻”，Beckwith 加了“as [?]”，意为豪梅亚化作该妻子的模样与子孙同眠；所列的妻名即 1765–1771 行所生的女子。

1950.note: 附录二：1951–1952 两行，底本第二行作 *Ae ka wahine*，因此利留卡拉尼译为“是的，妻子”。

1951.note: 哈洛阿之名在这里插入豪梅亚与之同眠的孙辈名单（[[ku:21]]）。

1953.en: Slept with her grandchild Waia as [?] his wife Huhune
1953.zh: 与孙子 Waia 同眠，Huhune 为妻

1954.en: Slept with her grandchild Hinanalo as [?] his wife Haunu'u
1954.zh: 与孙子 Hinanalo 同眠，Haunu‘u 为妻

1955.en: Slept with her grandchild Nanakahili as [?] his wife Haulani
1955.zh: 与孙子 Nanakahili 同眠，Haulani 为妻

1956.en: Slept with her grandchild Wailoa as [?] his wife Hikapuaneiea
1956.zh: 与孙子 Wailoa 同眠，Hikopuaneiea 为妻

1957.en: Ki'o was born, Haumea was recognized
1957.zh: Ki‘o 出生了，豪梅亚被认出

1958.en: Haumea was seen to be shriveled
1958.zh: 人们看见豪梅亚已经干瘪

1960.en: The woman was in fact gone sour

1961.en: Hard to deal with and crabbed

1962.en: Unsound, a fraud, half blind, a woman generations old
1962.zh: 不健全，是骗子，半瞎，历经多代的女人

1964.en: Bent and grey the breast, worthless was [the one of] Nu'u-mea [?]
1964.zh: 胸脯佝偻灰白，Nu‘umea 的[那人]已无用 [?]

1965.en: She lived licentiously, bore children like a dog
1965.zh: 她放荡度日，像狗一样生子

1966.en: With Ki'o came forth the chiefs
1966.zh: 由 Ki‘o 生出了诸酋长

1967.en: He slept with Kamole, with the woman of the woodland
1967.zh: 他与 Kamole，那林中的女人同眠

1968.en: Born was Ole, Ha'i was the wife
1968.zh: 生了 Ole 为夫，Ha‘i 为妻

1969.note: Beckwith：从 Ki‘o 往下七代到 1974 行的基伊（[[ku:20]]）。

1975.note: 基伊与 Hinako‘ula 生 ‘Ulu 与 Nana‘ulu 两子；所有夏威夷酋长都把世系追溯到二者之一。《库穆利波》从 ‘Ulu 续下（[[ku:20]]）。

1976.note: 从 ‘Ulu 一系续下，1983–1984 两行 Beckwith 有译文（[[ku:22]]）。

1983.en: Waolena was the man, Mahui'e the wife

1984.en: Akalana was the man, Hina-of-the-fire the wife
1984.zh: 阿卡拉纳为夫，Hina-a-ke-ahi 为妻

1985.en: Born was Maui the first, born was Maui the middle one
1985.zh: 生了长子毛伊，生了居中的毛伊
1985.note: 以下是毛伊的名号颂（*inoa*），讲他作为异系所生的幼子争夺地位的故事（[[ku:22]]）。毛伊故事见第一本书[[ch:15]]。

1986.en: Born was Maui-ki'iki'i, born was Maui of the loincloth
1986.zh: 生了 Maui-kiki‘i，生了缠腰布之毛伊 Maui-a-ka-malo
1986.note: 南方通称 Maui-tikitiki；“缠腰布之毛伊”这一称号，Beckwith 说只见于夏威夷与新西兰（[[ku:22]]）。

1987.en: The loincloth with which Akalana girded his loins
1987.zh: 那是阿卡拉纳束在腰间的缠腰布

1988.en: Hina-of-the-fire conceived, a fowl was born
1988.zh: Hina-a-ke-ahi 怀了孕，生下一只禽鸟
1988.note: Hina-a-ke-ahi，“火之希娜”。*moa*，通常译作公鸡；Beckwith 认为对应南方毛伊所化的鸽子（*rupe*），夏威夷没有鸽子，诗人便用斗鸡作象征（[[ku:22]]）。

1989.en: The child of Hina was delivered in the shape of an egg
1989.zh: 希娜所怀的孩子是一枚蛋
1989.note: 附录二：底本误印 *hookahua*，并在 *keiki* 后加逗号。

1990.en: She had not slept with a fowl

1992.en: The child chirped, Hina was puzzled
1992.zh: 孩子啾啾鸣叫，希娜困惑

1993.en: Not from sleeping with a man did this child come
1993.zh: 并非与人同眠，才有这孩子

1994.en: It was a strange child for Hina-of-the-fire
1994.zh: 这是 Hina-a-ke-ahi 的一个奇异的孩子
1994.note: *aiwaiwa*，既指非凡、出众，也有“臭名远扬”之义（[[ku:22]]）。

1995.en: The two guards [?] were angry, the tall and the short one
1995.zh: 两个守卫恼怒了，高的 Kia‘i-loa 与矮的 Kia‘i-a-ka-poko

1997.en: The two guards within the cave

1999.en: Red blood flowed from the brow [?] of Maui
1999.zh: 红色的血从毛伊额上流下

2000.zh: 这是毛伊的第一场争斗
2000.note: *ua*，Beckwith 译作 strife（争斗），把毛伊的功绩逐一编号；毛利人称毛伊的“功业”为 *patunga*（[[ku:22]]）。

2001.en: He fetched the bunch of black kava of Kane and Kanaloa
2001.zh: 他取来卡内与卡纳洛亚的那丛黑 ‘awa
2001.note: 用黑茎品种酿的 ‘awa（卡瓦）酒是“神”的专属（[[ku:22]]）。

2002.en: That was the second strife of Maui
2002.zh: 这是毛伊的第二场争斗

2003.en: The third strife was the quarrel over the kava strainer
2003.zh: 第三场争斗，是为 ‘awa 滤网起的争执

2004.en: The fourth strife was for the bamboo of Kane and Kanaloa
2004.zh: 第四场争斗，是为卡内与卡纳洛亚的竹
2004.note: Beckwith 猜测“竹”指割礼用的竹刀，或也只限酋长阶层（[[ku:22]]）。

2005.en: The fifth strife was over the temple inclosure for images [?]
2005.zh: 第五场争斗，是为神庙中供神像的围场 [?]
2005.note: *paehumu*，神庙中放置神像的围场；其右立着祈祷塔 *anu‘u*，二处都只许高级者进入（[[ku:22]]）。附录二：底本作 *pae he uma*。

2006.en: The sixth strife was over the prayer tower in the heiau [?]
2006.zh: 第六场争斗，是为神庙中的祈祷塔 [?]

2007.en: Maui reflected, asked who was his father
2007.zh: 毛伊沉思，问谁是他的父亲

2009.en: The loincloth of Kalana, that was your father"
2009.zh: Kalana 的缠腰布，那就是你的父亲。”

2011.en: He learned to fish, Hina sent him
2011.zh: 他学会了钓鱼，Hina-a-ke-ahi 差遣他

2013.en: There is the line, the hook

2014.note: *manai* 是穿花环用的尖针。Beckwith 认为钓起陆地的远行象征去远方亲族中求娶妻子（[[ku:22]]）。

2015.en: For drawing together the lands of old ocean"
2015.zh: 用来把古老大洋中的陆地拉到一起。”

2016.en: He seized the great mudhen of Hina
2016.zh: 他捉住了希娜的大水鸡
2016.note: *‘alae*，夏威夷水鸡。民间故事中毛伊从水鸡那里学到钻木取火，此处却未提及（[[ku:22]]）。

2018.en: That was the seventh strife of Maui
2018.zh: 这是毛伊的第七场争斗

2019.zh: 他钩住了那顽劣的变形者

2020.en: The jaw of Pimoe as it snapped open

2021.en: The lordly fish that shouts over the ocean
2021.zh: 那在大洋上轰鸣的主宰之鱼

2022.en: Pimoe crouched in the presence of Maui
2022.zh: 皮莫埃在毛伊面前伏下

2023.zh: 对 Mahanaulu‘ehu 生出了爱意
2023.note: 附录二：Kamokuiki 谱系本以 Mahanaulu‘ehu 为毛伊之妻；第十六 wā（2049 行）与 Fornander 称之为 Hinakealohaila（[[ku:22]]）。

2025.en: Maui drew them [?] ashore and ate all but the tailfin
2025.zh: 毛伊把它们拉上岸，吃得只剩尾鳍

2026.en: Kane and Kanaloa were shaken from their foundation
2026.zh: 卡内与卡纳洛亚被震离了根基

2027.en: By the ninth strife of Maui
2027.zh: 这是毛伊的第九场争斗

2028.zh: 皮莫埃“靠尾鳍活了下来”
2028.note: “靠尾巴活下来”是绝处逢生的俗语，出自鲨鱼 Mikololou 被吃得只剩尾巴（一说舌头）又复活的故事（[[ku:22]]）。

2031.en: Pe'ape'a, god of the octopus family

2032.zh: 那是毛伊最后一场争斗

2033.en: He scratched out the eyes of the eight-eyed Pe'ape'a
2033.zh: 他抓瞎了八眼的 Pe‘ape‘a 的眼睛

2034.note: Beckwith 在毛伊岛听到的说法：Moemoe 嘲弄毛伊，被打倒后化为 Kaanapali 海边的大黑石（[[ku:22]]）。

2035.en: Everyone knows about the battle of Maui with the sun
2035.zh: 毛伊与太阳之战，人人皆知

2036.en: With the loop of Maui's snaring-rope

2039.en: He drank the yellow water to the dregs [?][^9]

2040.zh: 卡内与卡纳洛亚的[黄水]

2042.zh: 绕遍夏威夷岛，绕遍毛伊岛

2043.zh: 绕遍考艾岛，绕遍瓦胡岛

2044.en: At Kahulu'u was the afterbirth [deposited], at Waikane the navel cord
2044.zh: 胞衣[埋]在 Kahulu‘u，脐带在 Waikane
2044.note: 结尾几行列出出身、出生地与埋葬地，是名号颂的典型简练笔法（[[ku:22]]）。Kahulu‘u、Waikāne、Hakipu‘u、Kualoa 都在瓦胡岛东岸。

2045.en: He died at Hakipu'u in Kualoa
2045.zh: 他死在 Kualoa 的 Hakipu‘u

2047.en: The lawless shape-shifter of the island
2047.zh: 岛上无法无天的变形者
2047.note: *ho‘okala*，Beckwith 认为译“无法无天”比通常的“淘气”更准确（[[ku:22]]）。

2048.note: *moku* 一语双关：既指岛屿，也指席卷其上的无法无天的酋长（[[ku:22]]）。

2049.en: Maui-son-of-Kalana was the man, Hina-kealohaila the wife
2049.note: 附录二：此 wā 的谱系可参 Kamokuiki 谱系本中的“哈洛阿的脊梁”（*Ke Kuamoo o Haloa*）、Malo（至 Palena 为止）与 Fornander；Fornander 无 Kapawa。

2055.en: Hulu-at-[the]-yellow-sky was the man, Hina-from-the-heavens the wife

2056.en: 'Ai-kanaka was the man, Hina-of-the-moon the wife
2056.zh: 艾卡纳卡为夫，Hina‘aiakamalama 为妻

2057.en: Born was Puna-the-first, born was Hema, born was Puna-the-last
2057.zh: 生了先出的 Puna、赫马、后出的 Puna

2058.en: Hema went after the birthgifts for the wife [?]
2058.zh: 赫马去 Luamahaheau 索取产礼 [?]
2058.note: 传说赫马为妻子生产去远方索取礼物而丧命，其子卡哈伊后来寻父（见第一本书[[ch:18]]）。

2059.en: Born was Kaha'i the great to Hema, Hina-ulu-'ohi'a was the wife
2059.zh: 生了大卡哈伊 Kaha‘i-nui-a-Hema，Hinaulu‘ohi‘a 为妻
2059.note: Beckwith 把此行译在 2058 行之前。

2060.en: Wahieloa was the man, Ho'olaukahili the wife
2060.zh: 瓦希埃洛阿为夫，Ho‘olaukahili 为妻

2061.en: Laka was the man, Hikawainui the wife
2061.note: Beckwith 英译把拉卡之妻写作 Hikawainui，与 2070 行 Palena 之妻同名；原文作 Hikawaolena。

2070.en: Palena was the man, Hikawainui the wife

2071.en: Born was Hanala'a-nui, born was Hanala'a-iki
2071.zh: 生了大 Hanala‘a，生了小 Hanala‘a
2071.note: Hanala‘a-nui 与 Hanala‘a-iki 是夏威夷谱系上重要支系的分歧点（[[ku:23]]）。

2089.en: Kahekili [the first] was the man, Hauanuihoni'ala was the wife
2089.zh: 卡赫基利为夫，Hauanuihoni‘ala 为妻

2090.en: Born was Kawauka'ohele and [his sister] Kelea-nui-noho-ana-'api'api ["Kelea-swimming-like-a-fish"]
2090.zh: 生了 Kawauka‘ohele，生了 Kelea-nui-noho-ana-‘api‘api，是女
2090.note: Kelea，以擅长冲浪著称的毛伊岛女酋长，她被掳到瓦胡岛、后嫁给 ‘Ewa 酋长的故事是宫廷传奇的常见题材（[[ku:23]]）。附录二：“是女”原在下一行行首。

2091.en: She [Kelea] lived as a wife to Kalamakua

2092.en: Born was La'ie-lohelohe, [she] lived with Pi'ilani, Pi'ikea was born
2092.zh: 生了 La‘ielohelohe，她与皮伊拉尼同住，[生了皮伊凯阿]

2093.zh: 皮伊凯阿与乌米同住，[生了] Kumalae-nui-a-‘Umi

2095.en: Kumulae-nui-a-'Umi was the man, Kumu-nui-puawale the wife

2096.en: Makua was the man, standing first of wohi rank on the island
2096.zh: Makua 为夫，岛上首屈一指的 wohi
2096.note: *wohi*，一种高级酋长品级，享有“俯伏禁忌”，即人们须在其面前俯伏（[[ku:23]]）。

2097.en: Kapo-hele-mai was the wife, a taboo wohi chiefess, the sacred one
2097.zh: Kapohelemai 为妻，禁忌的 wohi 女酋长，神圣者

2098.en: 'I, to 'I is the chiefship, the right to offer human sacrifice
2098.note: ‘I 家族是夏威夷岛希洛地区的强大家族。献人祭与砍 ‘ohi‘a 木造神像之权，意味着可以兴建战争神庙（[[ku:23]]）。

2099.en: The ruler over the land section of Pakini
2099.note: Pakini 在夏威夷岛 Ka‘u 区。

2100.en: With the right to cut down 'ohi'a wood for images, the protector of the island of Hawaii
2100.zh: 砍伐 ‘ohi‘a 木造神像，夏威夷岛的护持者

2101.en: To Ahu, Ahu son of 'I, to Lono
2101.zh: 传给 Ahu，传给 Ahu-a-‘I，传给洛诺

2102.zh: 传给洛诺伊卡马卡希基
2102.note: 全诗到此结束：据 Beckwith，Keawe 与 ‘I 家族的一位女儿生下洛诺伊卡马卡希基，这首颂歌相传就是献给他的（[[ku:23]]）。
